result:
The title and backdrop work is shipped as v31.19. The critic still gives screen 45 a 3 out of 5, short of his finish line of 4, and I did not measure 4K frame rate.

- **What changed this run:** the blur behind the scoreboard, how-to and other attract pages went from 5px to 2px (`cw-title-sharp`). At 5px the pillager-versus-robot fights were smeared into mud. Now both fights read clearly on screen 45, one on each side of the card. The blur is also a full-screen filter on a moving canvas every frame, so the lighter setting should be cheaper at 4K.
- **Fixture:** old check 30.82 demanded exactly 5px. I retargeted it to accept 5px or 2px, committed as 9b874ee9.
- **Gates:** it passed preflight and the ship gate, and the seed 4242 fingerprint is unchanged.
- **Critic on 45:** it scored 3 and called the picture the same. Its remaining findings are about the card itself: the "press any key" prompt is not a button, the card has no header or footer rows, the "no scores yet" text is centred, and the close X border is too heavy. That is the shared attract-card work, not the backdrop. It also asked for a .80 scrim and 8px blur, which would contradict Q52/Q54, so I skipped it.
- **Not measured:** I have no tool to measure 60 fps at 4K. The fight is 4 bodies, a few bolts and at most 90 sparks, so I expect it to be cheap.
- **Screens 01, 44, 46, 56, 57:** I only re-shot and viewed 01, 45 and 46. I ran the critic only on 45, and screen 01 still scores 3 from the earlier run.
- **Pictures and log:** before and after pictures are in `notes/shots/03-r8` and `03-r8after`. The line for this change is in `notes/ui/changes.md`, and my notes are in `notes/03-title-and-backdrop.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: Q50, Q51, Q53, Q72 and the live fight backdrop (Q52/Q54) are all shipped. The critic scores 3 on 01 and 45, so the 4-or-more finish line is not reached. What remains is not the backdrop: the attract card structure, and the title's saves block, five mode rows and logo gradient. I also have not measured 60 fps at 4K.
